TECHNICAL DATA SHEET 
 
 Spray-Net Exclusive Paint Series  
 Stain Blocking High-Build Primer  
 
 
DESCRIPTION: Spray-Net’s exclusive stain blocking 
high-build primer is a water-based primer formulated to 
stop tannins and stains from bleeding through paint and 
causing discoloration. It has excellent adhesion to a 
variety of substrates such as Melamine, MDF, veneers 
and natural wood. This product blocks tannin migration 
in one coat in most cases, for stubborn bleeding a 
second coat may be required. 
 
APPLICATIONS: Spray-Net’s Exclusive stain blocking 
high-build primer is designed for interior wood 
applications such as Kitchen Cabinets and wood 
furniture.  
 
 
SURFACE PREPARATION: All surfaces must be clean, dry 
and free of dirt, grease, wax and chipped & peeling 
paint before painting. Remove all loose and peeling 
paint and sand to smooth edges. Repair holes and 
cracks with filler suitable for the surface to be repaired. 
Sand all surfaces smooth. 
 
PRODUCT PREPARATION: Mix and redisperse by stirring 
with a paint paddle/mixer followed by thorough mixing to 
a uniform, homogeneous consistency. Avoid high speed 
agitation. Spray-Net’s exclusive stain blocking high-build 
primer does not mix well with the other paints so make 
sure to flush your system thoroughly before and after 
using the primer.  
 
THINNING / REDUCTION: Not required. 
APPLICATION EQUIPMENT: Apply primer on kitchen 
cabinets and furniture using a Graco GX19 with a 308 to 
312 tip depending on required thickness. 
APPLICATION GUIDELINES: Apply in a uniform wet film 
thickness of 4-6 mil, apply only when air and surface 
temperatures are above 10°C (50°F). 
 
DRYING SCHEDULE: Dry to touch may take up to 1 hour 
(Humidity and temperature dependent).  
Force Dry: Allow product to flash for 10 minutes at ambient 
temperature and use infrared lamps to heat the surface to a 
maximum of 40°C (105°F). Allow it to cool before sanding.  
 
CLEANUP: Thoroughly flush equipment and lines with warm 
water. 
 
PRECAUTIONS: Refer/Read Material Safety Data Sheet 
(MSDS), familiarize and observe all container warnings and 
labeling prior to use. Use in a well-ventilated area. Do not 
open containers until they are ready to use. Keep lid on 
container when not in use. Use in accordance with local 
regulations including environmental. Shelf Life 12 months 
maximum in original sealed unopened container.
